bible_quanes.question: What does 1 John 1:5 say about God?
bible_quanes.answer: God is light, and in Him is no darkness at all

bible_quanes.question: What does God do if we confess our sins?
bible_quanes.answer: He is faithful and just to forgive us and cleanse us from all unrighteousness

bible_quanes.question: What cleanses us from all sin?
bible_quanes.answer: The blood of Jesus Christ His Son
bible_quanes.explanation: If we walk in the light.

bible_quanes.question: What happens if we say we have no sin?
bible_quanes.answer: We deceive ourselves
bible_quanes.explanation: And the truth is not in us.

bible_quanes.question: What did the apostles hear, see and handle?
bible_quanes.answer: The Word of life

bible_quanes.question: With whom is our fellowship?
bible_quanes.answer: With the Father and with His Son Jesus Christ

bible_quanes.question: Why was 1 John written?
bible_quanes.answer: That your joy may be full

bible_quanes.question: What are we if we claim fellowship but walk in darkness?
bible_quanes.answer: We lie, and do not the truth

bible_quanes.question: What do we make God if we say we have not sinned?
bible_quanes.answer: A liar
bible_quanes.explanation: His word is not in us.

bible_quanes.question: How is the life described in 1 John 1:2?
bible_quanes.answer: The eternal life which was with the Father and was manifested to us

bible_quanes.question: Whom do we have as an Advocate with the Father?
bible_quanes.answer: Jesus Christ the righteous

bible_quanes.question: What should we not love?
bible_quanes.answer: The world or the things in the world
bible_quanes.explanation: The love of the Father is not in him.

bible_quanes.question: Who abides for ever?
bible_quanes.answer: He that doeth the will of God

bible_quanes.question: What is Christ for our sins?
bible_quanes.answer: The propitiation

bible_quanes.question: How do we know that we know Him?
bible_quanes.answer: If we keep His commandments

bible_quanes.question: Where is one who hates his brother?
bible_quanes.answer: In darkness until now

bible_quanes.question: What is in the world?
bible_quanes.answer: The lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes and the pride of life

bible_quanes.question: What has come in the last hour?
bible_quanes.answer: Many antichrists

bible_quanes.question: Who is the liar, according to 1 John 2:22?
bible_quanes.answer: He that denieth that Jesus is the Christ

bible_quanes.question: What abides in believers and teaches them?
bible_quanes.answer: The anointing which ye have received of him

bible_quanes.question: What does 1 John 3:1 say about God's love?
bible_quanes.answer: That we should be called the sons of God

bible_quanes.question: What will we be when He is revealed?
bible_quanes.answer: Like Him, for we shall see Him as He is

bible_quanes.question: How should we love?
bible_quanes.answer: Not in word or tongue, but in deed and in truth

bible_quanes.question: By what do we know love?
bible_quanes.answer: He laid down His life for us

bible_quanes.question: Why was the Son of God manifested?
bible_quanes.answer: To destroy the works of the devil

bible_quanes.question: Who was of the wicked one and killed his brother?
bible_quanes.answer: Cain

bible_quanes.question: What is whoever hates his brother?
bible_quanes.answer: A murderer

bible_quanes.question: What is greater than our heart?
bible_quanes.answer: God

bible_quanes.question: What is sin, according to 1 John 3:4?
bible_quanes.answer: The transgression of the law

bible_quanes.question: By what do we know He abides in us?
bible_quanes.answer: By the Spirit which he hath given us

bible_quanes.question: What is God, according to 1 John 4:8?
bible_quanes.answer: Love
bible_quanes.explanation: He who does not love does not know God.

bible_quanes.question: Why do we love Him?
bible_quanes.answer: Because He first loved us

bible_quanes.question: Who is greater than he who is in the world?
bible_quanes.answer: He that is in you

bible_quanes.question: What does perfect love cast out?
bible_quanes.answer: Fear
bible_quanes.explanation: There is no fear in love.

bible_quanes.question: What should we do with every spirit?
bible_quanes.answer: Try the spirits whether they are of God

bible_quanes.question: By what do we know the Spirit of God?
bible_quanes.answer: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh

bible_quanes.question: What is love, according to 1 John 4:10?
bible_quanes.answer: Not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son

bible_quanes.question: What is someone who says he loves God but hates his brother?
bible_quanes.answer: A liar
bible_quanes.explanation: He cannot love God whom he has not seen.

bible_quanes.question: What has no one seen at any time?
bible_quanes.answer: God
bible_quanes.explanation: But if we love one another, He abides in us.

bible_quanes.question: As what did the Father send the Son?
bible_quanes.answer: The Saviour of the world

bible_quanes.question: What is the victory that overcomes the world?
bible_quanes.answer: Our faith

bible_quanes.question: Who has life?
bible_quanes.answer: He that hath the Son
bible_quanes.explanation: He who does not, does not have life.

bible_quanes.question: Why was 1 John 5 written?
bible_quanes.answer: That you may know you have eternal life

bible_quanes.question: What is the love of God?
bible_quanes.answer: That we keep His commandments

bible_quanes.question: By what did Jesus come?
bible_quanes.answer: Water and blood

bible_quanes.question: What is the testimony God has given?
bible_quanes.answer: Eternal life, and this life is in His Son

bible_quanes.question: What confidence do we have in Him?
bible_quanes.answer: If we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us

bible_quanes.question: How does 1 John end?
bible_quanes.answer: "Little children, keep yourselves from idols"

bible_quanes.question: What kind of sin does John say not to pray about?
bible_quanes.answer: A sin unto death

bible_quanes.question: What has the Son of God given us?
bible_quanes.answer: An understanding, that we may know Him who is true
